methods.label: Evaluate the exponents first
methods.explanation:
First calculate the exponents: \(5^2=25\) and \(2^5=32\). An odd power of \(-1\) equals \(-1\), and every positive integer power of \(1\) equals \(1\). Therefore
\[
(-1)^{5^2}+1^{2^5}
=(-1)^{25}+1^{32}
=-1+1=\boxed{0},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
